title.en: An Act to Appropriate the Sum of Fifty Thousand Pesos for the Holding of the XIVth World Congress on Tourism in the Philippines in November, Nineteen Hundred Fifty-Nine, and for the Acquisition and Installation of Adequate Conference Equipment, Services and Supplies

text.en: There is hereby appropriated the sum of fifty thousand pesos, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to cover expenses required for the holding of the World Congress on Tourism in November, nineteen hundred fifty-nine, including the acquisition and installation of modern conference hall equipment and facilities, communication and transportation services and essential conference supplies.

The fund hereby appropriated shall be made immediately available upon approval of this Act and be at the disposal of the Board of Travel and Tourist Industry, which shall be responsible for its expenditure as well as for the safekeeping and any future use of the conference equipment to be acquired.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 20, 1959.
